purpose: Fresh independent verification of the Python test-corpus audit after repairing runtime sibling-module loading.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
p=root/'canonical/runtime/bound_capabilities/python_test_audit.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('pta_verify',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
r=m.run({'source_root':'canonical/tests','pattern':'test_*.py','output_path':'canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/CANONICAL_TEST_AUDIT_VERIFY.json','timeout_s':180},root)
print(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True)); print('PYTHON_TEST_AUDIT_ADAPTER_COMPLETE')
PY

set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,re,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve(); tests=root/'canonical/tests'
report=json.loads((root/'canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/CANONICAL_TEST_AUDIT_VERIFY.json').read_text())
files=sorted(p for p in tests.glob('test_*.py') if p.is_file())
records={x['path']:x for x in report['records']}
assert set(records)=={str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/') for p in files}
tot={'files':0,'tests':0,'passed':0,'failed':0,'errors':0,'skipped':0}
for p in files:
 proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(p)],cwd=root,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=180)
 combined=(proc.stdout or '')+'\n'+(proc.stderr or '')
 assert proc.returncode==0,(str(p),combined[-2000:])
 m=re.search(r'Ran\s+(\d+)\s+tests?\s+in\s+[0-9.]+s',combined); assert m,(str(p),combined[-1000:])
 ran=int(m.group(1)); skipped=0
 sm=re.search(r'OK\s*\(([^)]*)\)',combined)
 if sm:
  z=re.search(r'skipped=(\d+)',sm.group(1)); skipped=int(z.group(1)) if z else 0
 rel=str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'); rec=records[rel]
 assert rec['exit_code']==0 and rec['tests']==ran and rec['failed']==0 and rec['errors']==0 and rec['skipped']==skipped
 tot['files']+=1; tot['tests']+=ran; tot['skipped']+=skipped; tot['passed']+=ran-skipped
 assert report['totals']==tot,(report['totals'],tot)
 print(json.dumps({'verified':True,'totals':tot},sort_keys=True)); print('PYTHON_TEST_AUDIT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED')
PY
